purpose: Marketplace catalogue backfill with marketplace stock/pre-book state, useful tags and corrected casing. Inventory ledger/FIFO/finance data intentionally excluded.

notes.stock: availableStock/stock/totalStock come from Current Stock for Catalogue. For isPrebook=true, this value is the remaining bookable quantity/slots.
notes.tags: tag is intentionally null. tags and subtags contain the same 1–3 meaningful marketplace discovery tags because the current backend/frontend use both as legacy fallbacks.
notes.images: image/images remain empty until the image lookup manifest is resolved and assets are uploaded to S3.
notes.casing: Explicit product-name cues override sheet Pack. Otherwise the sheet Pack is used. If unavailable, fallback is Box for Mini GT, Acrylic for Pop Race, Other for other brands.
